llm.summary: This is a small planning/checklist skill for Nextcloud support requests, with no executable code or credential handling, though its trigger wording is too broad.

dimensions.detail: The artifact consistently describes helping users plan, analyze, implement, or verify an enhancement request to add Nextcloud support.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill is narrow in purpose but uses broad trigger words such as add, support, feature, request, related, and problem, plus implicit invocation, so it may activate in unrelated conversations.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains only SKILL.md, agents/openai.yaml, and a markdown reference file; no scripts, installers, or executable files are present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions ask the agent to inspect constraints, propose steps, and include verification commands when relevant, which is proportionate for implementation support.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background worker, credential access, local indexing, network automation, or privilege escalation is requested by the artifacts.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you want help with planning or implementing Nextcloud support. Be aware it may activate too often because of broad keywords; prefer explicit invocation or tighten the trigger wording to require Nextcloud-related context.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] unexpected: The broad trigger list in SKILL.md is real and should be tightened, but it is a routing quality issue rather than evidence of malicious behavior.
[SQP-1] unexpected: The frontmatter description includes generic activation terms that could over-match unrelated requests; the rest of the skill remains aligned to Nextcloud support.
[SQP-1] expected: Implicit invocation is declared openly in agents/openai.yaml; combined with broad triggers it increases misrouting risk, but it does not add hidden capabilities.
[SQP-1] unexpected: The reference file repeats broad usage signals; this reinforces the over-triggering concern but does not introduce unsafe actions or data access.
